questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the power of Parliament to amend the Constitution?
questions.explanation: Article 368 provides the mechanism for Parliament to amend the Constitution.

questions.question: The first State in India to adopt the Panchayat system of local self-government was?
questions.explanation: West Bengal was the first State to adopt the Panchayat system in 1959.

questions.question: What is the name of the highest court in the State of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Calcutta High Court is the highest court in the State of West Bengal.

questions.question: The provisions of the Indian Constitution that deal with the relationship between the Centre and the States are contained in which Part?
questions.explanation: Part XI of the Indian Constitution deals with the relationship between the Centre and the States.

questions.question: What is the name of the Bill that was passed in 1992 to provide for the protection of children in difficult circumstances in West Bengal?
options: West Bengal Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Bill, 1992
West Bengal Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Bill, 1992
questions.explanation: The West Bengal Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Bill, 1992, was passed to protect children in difficult circumstances.

questions.question: Which of the following rivers is the main source of water for the Sundarbans mangrove forest?
questions.explanation: The Ganges River is the main source of water for the Sundarbans mangrove forest.

questions.question: What is the highest peak in the Darjeeling Himalayan hill region of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: Siniolchu is the highest peak in the Darjeeling Himalayan hill region of West Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following is a major delta in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Ganges-Brahmaputra Delta is a major delta in West Bengal.

questions.question: What is the name of the largest wetland in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: Gangani Beel is the largest wetland in West Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following mountain ranges is partially located in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Eastern Himalayas are partially located in West Bengal.

questions.question: The Swasthya Sathi scheme was launched by the Government of West Bengal in which year?
questions.explanation: It was launched in 2016.

questions.question: Which of the following West Bengal government schemes provides financial assistance to the women of the state?
questions.explanation: It provides financial assistance to the women.

questions.question: What is the main objective of the 'Duare Dak' scheme launched by the Government of West Bengal?
options: To provide ration to the poor
To provide financial assistance to the farmers
To deliver government services at the doorstep
To provide health insurance to the people
questions.explanation: To deliver government services at the doorstep.

questions.question: The Paray Mi Paray scheme was launched by the Government of West Bengal in which year?
questions.explanation: It was launched in 2020.

questions.question: Which of the following is a flagship scheme of the Government of West Bengal to provide free education to girls?
questions.explanation: It is a flagship scheme of the government.

questions.question: A shopkeeper in Kolkata buys 15 kg of potatoes at the rate of ₹ 18 per kg. He sells them at a 20% profit. What is the profit percentage if he sells the potatoes at ₹ 24 per kg?
questions.explanation: Profit percentage is calculated on the cost price.

questions.question: A local dairy in West Bengal sells milk at a price that includes a 15% commission to the distributor and a 10% sales tax. If the distributor's commission is ₹ 2.50 on a can of milk, what is the original price of the milk can?
questions.explanation: Commission and tax are added to the original price.

questions.question: A farmer in West Bengal sells wheat at ₹ 20 per kg, earning a 25% profit. If he buys the wheat at ₹ 16 per kg, what is his total profit on selling 120 kg of wheat?
questions.explanation: Profit is the difference between the selling and cost prices.

questions.question: A local store in Kolkata sells a product at a discount of 10% for the first 50 units and 20% for the next 50 units. If the store earns ₹ 5000 by selling 100 units at the discounted prices, what is the original selling price per unit?
questions.explanation: Discounts are subtracted from the original price.

questions.question: A West Bengal government agency buys 2000 kg of rice at ₹ 22.50 per kg and sells it at a 35% profit. If the profit is ₹ 10,000, what is the selling price per kg of rice?
questions.explanation: Profit is the difference between the selling and cost prices.

questions.question: A train travels from Howrah to Sealdah covering a distance of 21 km in 1 hour. What is the approximate speed of the train in kmph?
questions.explanation: Speed is calculated as distance divided by time.

questions.question: A car travels from Kolkata to Digha covering a distance of 180 km in 3 hours. What is the time taken to cover the next 90 km of the journey at the same speed?
questions.explanation: Time is calculated as distance divided by speed.

questions.question: A motorist covers a certain distance at 40 kmph and returns at 60 kmph. What is the average speed of the motorist for the entire journey?
questions.explanation: Average speed is calculated as total distance divided by total time.

questions.question: A bus travels from Siliguri to Darjeeling covering a distance of 80 km in 2 hours. What is the time taken to cover the next 20 km of the journey at the same speed?
questions.explanation: Time is calculated as distance divided by speed.

questions.question: A train starts from Kolkata and travels to Bardhaman at an average speed of 50 kmph. If the distance between the two cities is 120 km, how much time will it take to cover this distance?
questions.explanation: Time is calculated as distance divided by speed.

questions.question: Kamal is the younger brother of Somen. Somen's wife is the mother of ______________.
questions.explanation: Kamal is Somen's younger brother.

questions.question: Biplab is the husband of Sushama. Sushama's sister is married to ______________.
questions.explanation: Biplab's younger brother is Sushama's sister's husband.

questions.question: Arindam is the father of Suman. Suman's maternal grandmother is the mother of ______________.
questions.explanation: Arindam's wife is Suman's maternal grandmother.

questions.question: Rahul is the elder brother of Surojit. Surojit's wife is the sister of ______________.
questions.explanation: Rahul's younger brother is Surojit's wife's brother.

questions.question: Sudipto is the husband of Kalyani. Kalyani's brother is married to ______________.
questions.explanation: Sudipto's elder sister is Kalyani's brother's wife.

questions.question: A person is facing a wall on the west side and then turns 90 degrees to the right. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: He turned to the right, so he is facing the north direction.

questions.question: A person is standing at the foot of a mountain on the banks of the Ganges River. He walks 5 km north along the river, then turns 90 degrees to the left and walks 4 km. Then he turns 90 degrees to the right and walks 3 km. In which direction is he now?
questions.explanation: After turning 90 degrees to the left, he is facing the west direction and walked 4 km, then turned 90 degrees to the right and walked 3 km, so he is facing the north direction.

questions.question: A man is standing on the banks of the Hooghly River. He walks 4 km along the river in a northerly direction, then turns 90 degrees to the left and walks 2 km, then turns 90 degrees to the right and walks 6 km. In which direction is he now?
questions.explanation: After turning 90 degrees to the left, he is facing the west direction and walked 2 km, then turned 90 degrees to the right and walked 6 km, so he is facing the east direction.

questions.question: A person is standing at the centre of a square plot with each side measuring 5 km. He walks 2 km towards the north and then turns 90 degrees to the right and walks 2 km. In which direction is he now?
questions.explanation: He walked 2 km towards the north and then turned 90 degrees to the right, so he is facing the west direction.

questions.question: A person is standing on the banks of a river and is facing a church on the other side. He walks 50 meters upstream and then turns 90 degrees to the right and walks 30 meters. Then he turns 90 degrees to the left and walks 20 meters. Which direction is he now facing?
questions.explanation: He walked 50 meters upstream, then turned 90 degrees to the right and walked 30 meters, and then turned 90 degrees to the left and walked 20 meters, so he is still facing the north direction.
